default.description: Default permissions for xpressclaw desktop app. No `remote` grant: these permissions (fs, shell, dialog, clipboard) are NOT exposed to the frontend served over http://localhost — only the minimal window-creation grant in remote-webview.json is.

remote-webview.description: Minimal IPC grant to the app's OWN frontend, which is served over http://localhost (remote content from Tauri's view). Applies to the main window and the detached android-live window. Grants ONLY window/webview creation + focus + enumeration (get-all-windows is what WebviewWindow.getByLabel calls under the hood; without it the detach flow dies on its first IPC call) + close (the detached window's reattach control; JS window.close() must NOT be used there — wry destroys only the WRY_WEBVIEW container HWND, stranding a blank window and a stale label) + event listen/unlisten (main watches tauri://destroyed to reattach the rail) — and DELIBERATELY nothing else. fs/shell/dialog/clipboard stay in `default` with no remote grant, so an XSS in the frontend can open a window at worst, not read the disk or spawn processes. Ports are pinned (prod 8935, dev 5173), not wildcarded.
